_comment: smc_rsi_frvp_options_v1 (smc1). Every parameter must be present; unknown keys are rejected. Keys starting with '_' are comments. Defaults are the spec's; see docs/strategies/smc_rsi_frvp_options_v1/DESIGN.md. Phase B: detector parameters only.

session._comment: NSE cash/F&O session, IST. Opening range = open..opening_range_end (spec 3.8).

pivots._comment: Fractal pivot lengths per timeframe (spec 3.1). left must equal right: the reused shared detect_pivots is symmetric. A pivot is usable only after 'right' bars have closed.

structure._comment: 15m bias (spec 3.3). A CHoCH not yet confirmed by a same-direction BOS is NEUTRAL when require_bos_after_choch. No structure event within bias_max_age_bars_15m -> NEUTRAL. use_1h_filter: 1H trend must not be opposite.

dealing_range._comment: Premium/discount around EQ = 50% of the 15m BOS leg (spec 3.4). OTE retracement band, tag only.

displacement._comment: Displacement candle (spec 3.5): body >= atr_mult x ATR(14, Wilder) and body/range >= body_ratio, part of a qualifying FVG.

fvg._comment: Fair value gap minimum size, x ATR(14, Wilder) (spec 3.6).

order_blocks._comment: Order blocks (spec 3.7). zone_mode 'full' = [low, high], 'body' = [min(o,c), max(o,c)]. Age limits in bars of the OB's timeframe. require_displacement: the leg must contain a displacement candle.

liquidity._comment: Liquidity pools and sweeps (spec 3.8). eq_tol_pct is in PERCENT (0.03 = 0.03%). eq_max_pivots_back is not in the spec (bounds equal-high pairing; DESIGN.md 13). sweep_reclaim_bars counts bars AFTER the sweep candle; 0 = the sweep candle itself must close back.

frvp._comment: Fixed range volume profile from 1m futures bars (spec 3.9). bin_points is the TARGET bin width (actual = range / ceil(range / bin_points)). history_sessions bounds the 1m buffer (not in the spec).

rsi._comment: RSI(14), Wilder, on 5m closes; divergence between the last two confirmed 5m pivots within div_max_bars (spec 3.10).

regime._comment: ATR (Wilder) length for every timeframe; chop filter: 15m ADX(adx_length) < adx_min AND no 15m BOS in the last chop_lookback_bars_15m bars (spec 3.11, 3.12).
